# crosswork_local_congestion_mitigation (Data Source)

This data source can read the local congestion mitigation configuration of one LCM domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_local_congestion_mitigation" "example" {
  id = "200"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `adjacency_hop_type` (String) Type of adjacency SID used when creating an SR policy
- `affinity_exclude_any` (List of String) Bit positions of the link affinities of the exclude any constraint
- `affinity_include_all` (List of String) Bit positions of the link affinities of the include all constraint
- `affinity_include_any` (List of String) Bit positions of the link affinities of the include any constraint
- `auto_repair_solution` (Boolean) Detect and deploy changes automatically after network failures
- `color` (Number) Color assigned sequentially to tactical SR policies starting with this value
- `congestion_check_interval` (Number) Interval in seconds used to evaluate the network for congestion
- `congestion_check_suspension_interval` (Number) Seconds to suspend congestion detection after any tactical SR policy change
- `debug_opt` (Boolean) Save debug plan files and set the log level to debug
- `debug_opt_max_files` (Number) Maximum number of debug plan file sets to save
- `delete_lsps` (Boolean) Delete all deployed tactical SR policies when LCM is disabled
- `description` (String) Description of the domain configuration
- `domain_id` (String) LCM domain identifier
- `enable` (Boolean) Enables LCM for the domain
- `history_retention_time` (Number) Days the collected data is retained
- `include_all_interfaces` (Boolean) Monitor congestion on all interfaces; false monitors the selected interfaces
- `max_tte_group` (Number) Maximum number of tactical policies used to mitigate a single interface
- `node_tag_max_sid_depth` (Map of String) Maximum SID depth (0 to 16) by device tag, written as a text number
- `objective` (String) Path computation objective of the tactical SR policies
- `operation_mode` (String) Operation mode of LCM; AUTOMATED needs gRPC on every device of the domain
- `overprovision_factor` (Number) Percentage deducted from interface thresholds to derive the effective threshold
- `pce_dispatch_timeout` (Number) Maximum time in seconds to confirm the deployment of tactical SR policies
- `profile_id` (Number) Profile ID assigned to all tactical SR policies; 0 assigns none
- `stay_in_area` (Boolean) Restrict bypass paths to the mitigated OSPF area or ISIS level
- `throttle_mode_threshold` (Number) Solution oscillations per hour that put the solution in the PAUSED state; 0 disables detection
- `uneven_ecmp_traffic_threshold` (Number) Sensitivity percentage to detect uneven traffic across solution bypass tunnels
- `utilization_hold_margin` (Number) Percentage that dampens the removal of deployed tactical SR policies
- `utilization_threshold` (Number) Utilization percentage at which an interface is considered congested
